name: prism_haleu
description: PRISM HALEU startup core: U-10Zr drivers, no Pu, at a 0.8338/0.1662 HALEU/DU blend (16.5% U-235, the Natrium DEMO advanced-fuel enrichment; ceiling 19.75%). Triplett breakeven geometry (Fig. 8 rods, USS, GEMs, source, notches; 23-month cycle; active height 106.7 cm), but the 42 internal blankets are drivers: a fresh-HALEU core with internal blankets would need about 24% U-235, above the HALEU limit. Inner fuel = rings 0-4, outer = rings 5-7; one enrichment, so inner/outer only name zones. Radial blanket = ring 8 minus corners (42), DU. Absorbers withdrawn. Pin designs (ANL-AFCI-202): drivers anl_sprism_driver, blankets anl_blanket. Search the enrichment with fuel_cycle.loading_search (u_fissile knob).
source: Project design. Geometry from Triplett, Loewen & Dooies, Nucl. Technol. 178 (2012) 186, Fig. 8 / Table III; HALEU vector from materials U_VECTORS['haleu']; 16.5% U-235 from P. Hejzlar, 'Fuel Cycle and Waste Management', TerraPower presentation (2021): 'Natrium DEMO with advanced fuel will operate with 16.5% enriched U loads to 150 MWd/kg'

overrides.comment: Triplett 2012 Fig. 8. (q, r) frame: (0, n) straight up, (n, -n) lower-right, (-n, 0) lower-left.
Ring 3 corners, alternating: 3 control (up, lower-right, lower-left) + 3 ultimate shutdown
Corner notch: ring-8 corners reflector, ring-10 corners shield, ring-11 corners empty
